article_title: Rare turtle Rhossi to be flown 5,000 miles home to Gulf of Mexico

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: How turtles are displayed in British aquariums
Rhossi's recovery in Wales and planned 5,000-mile return to the Gulf of Mexico
Why cargo flights no longer carry animals
A new turtle species discovered in Texas
tasks.correct_answer: Rhossi's recovery in Wales and planned 5,000-mile return to the Gulf of Mexico
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת את שיקומו של רושי בוויילס ואת התכנון להטיסו כ־5,000 מייל חזרה לבית הגידול שלו במפרץ מקסיקו.

tasks.prompt: Where was Rhossi found after being washed ashore?
options: Padre Island in Texas
A beach in Mexico
Traeth Llydan beach on Anglesey, Wales
Near Heathrow Airport
tasks.correct_answer: Traeth Llydan beach on Anglesey, Wales
tasks.explanation_hebrew: רושי נמצא על חוף Traeth Llydan שבאי אנגלסי בוויילס, רחוק מאוד מבית הגידול הטבעי שלו.

tasks.prompt: In Rhossi's story, what does “rehabilitated” mean?
options: Moved into permanent captivity
Measured before a flight
Given a new scientific name
Treated until healthy enough to return to the wild
tasks.correct_answer: Treated until healthy enough to return to the wild
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר של הכתבה, rehabilitated פירושו שטופל ושוקם עד שיוכל לחזור בבטחה לטבע.

tasks.prompt: What kind of turtle is Rhossi?
options: A critically endangered Kemp's ridley sea turtle
A common green sea turtle
A freshwater snapping turtle
A newly discovered Welsh turtle
tasks.correct_answer: A critically endangered Kemp's ridley sea turtle
tasks.explanation_hebrew: רושי הוא צב ים מסוג Kemp's ridley, הנחשב לאחד ממיני צבי הים הנדירים ובסכנת הכחדה חמורה.

tasks.prompt: Why is a temperature-controlled transport crate important for Rhossi's journey?
options: It lets visitors watch him during the flight
It helps protect a delicate animal from harmful temperature changes and dehydration
It allows him to swim across the Atlantic
It removes the need for specialist supervision
tasks.correct_answer: It helps protect a delicate animal from harmful temperature changes and dehydration
tasks.explanation_hebrew: צב ים משוקם ורגיש זקוק לטמפרטורה וללחות מבוקרות בזמן הובלה ארוכה כדי למנוע פגיעה והתייבשות.

tasks.prompt: What does “cargo” refer to in the description of Rhossi's flight?
options: The beach where he was found
The team caring for him
Goods or special loads transported by aircraft
The moment an aircraft leaves the ground
tasks.correct_answer: Goods or special loads transported by aircraft
tasks.explanation_hebrew: cargo הוא מטען המובל במטוס; רושי אמור לטוס בטיסת מטען מיוחדת בדרכו לטקסס.

tasks.prompt: Describe two stages of Rhossi's planned journey from Anglesey to the Gulf of Mexico.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני שלבים נכונים מתוך מסלול ההובלה המתואר, בסדר הגיוני וללא פרטים מומצאים.
expected_points: A volunteer helicopter pilot will fly him from Anglesey to Denham Aerodrome
He will travel by road to Heathrow Airport
He and his carer will take a cargo flight to Houston before his release near the Gulf of Mexico

tasks.prompt: Summarise Rhossi's story from his discovery to his planned release in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את מציאתו בוויילס, מצבו, השיקום והחזרה המתוכננת, תוך שמירה על רצף ברור.
expected_points: He was found cold-stunned and close to death on an Anglesey beach
Anglesey Sea Zoo cared for and rehabilitated him for more than two years
A specialist transport plan will take him about 5,000 miles to Texas
The goal is to release him in his native Gulf of Mexico habitat

tasks.prompt: Why do conservationists believe returning Rhossi to his native habitat is better than keeping him permanently in captivity?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הקשר בין בית גידול טבעי, התנהגות המין וסיכויי הישרדות, בהתבסס על הכתבה.
expected_points: Kemp's ridley turtles belong mainly in the Gulf of Mexico
Release allows natural behaviour rather than a life in captivity
Returning a rehabilitated rare animal supports conservation and species survival

tasks.prompt: Explain why Rhossi's rescue requires cooperation between animal carers, transport specialists and authorities.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את התרומה של לפחות שני גורמים ולחבר אותה לצורכי הבריאות, ההיתרים והמסע הארוך.
expected_points: Animal specialists prepared and monitored Rhossi's health
Transport experts arranged a temperature-controlled crate and several travel stages
Authorities had to approve the international movement and eventual release of an endangered species
